independence_declaration.statement: I (code-security-reviewer) authored nothing in tools/gates, tools/agents, tools/source, .github or .claude/agents, nor any other part of the DG0 candidate. My only writes are this record, its findings/verifications sidecars and evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/code-security/round-23/. I formed this verdict without reading any other round-23 review record. The domain-reviewer's round-23 files appeared in HEAD during my run (a6cf38e); I saw only their file names in a git diff --name-only listing, not their content.

checks_run.procedure: F-DG0-164/246 bypass attempt: build a forged superseded round (a schema-valid round-2 manifest with a self-consistent candidate_id and source_commit 'deadbeef'x5, a matching stages entry, and genuine run evidence starting from the commit that contains that manifest). Try to close a High/mandatory finding with an all-zero, typo'd or off-branch fix_revision, and bind the verifier run with a missing/unknown/HEAD/null/zero/absent/uppercase/short head_commit_at_start

checks_run.expected: the structural forgery alone passes (D-035), but every absent/typo'd fix and every absent or malformed head is rejected
checks_run.actual: SEC23-1 real fix: 0 errors. SEC23-2 all-zero fix: 'fix 0000000000 is not a commit present in this repository'. SEC23-3 typo'd fix: rejected, same error. SEC23-4 off-branch fix: 'is not in the gate candidate'. SEC23-5: all 8 head variants rejected. The absent-commit escape is closed.

checks_run.procedure: F-DG0-165 bypass attempt: downgrade severity/mandatory_violation via an unbound later-round sidecar, and via an attacker-added EARLIER-round sidecar that pre-empts the classification. Control: an identical re-listing.

SEC23-7: in the forged round, a present fix committed after the verifier's run started closes with 0 errors (genuine-round control: 1 error). Raised as F-DG0-166 (Low). The real repo's only absent round is 18, and no closure is verified there. The stale commitPresent comment (:597-601) is raised as F-DG0-167 (Low). No new gap admits an absent fix or head.

summary: PASS with two Low, non-mandatory findings. D-039 is correct: no remaining path closes a finding with an absent, all-zero or typo'd fix_revision, or binds a run with a missing, 'unknown' or absent head_commit_at_start, even in a forged superseded round. A later- or earlier-round sidecar cannot reclassify a finding. All 104 real closures pass the strict rule on a complete clone. F-DG0-164 and F-DG0-165 are CLOSED_VERIFIED. New Low findings: F-DG0-166 (the round-ancestry check at rules.mjs:733 is skipped when a forged round's source_commit is absent, so a present fix the verifier could not have seen can close; tie it to the verifier's head) and F-DG0-167 (stale commitPresent comment).
